summary: Completed the role-aware reviewer-dispatch implementation and fixed a critical identity-attribution hazard: reviewer_inbox previously used agentId both as the inbox subject and caller activity identity, so Manager reads could falsely mark reviewers active and release uncertain-launch reservations. ReviewerInbox now separates caller agentId from optional reviewerId (defaulting to agentId for existing self-inbox callers); Manager instructions use Manager agentId plus the selected reviewerId. Added API/schema and caller-attribution regression tests. Focused Manager heartbeat tests passed 36/36; Server.Tests Release command exited 0; diff check and clean-worktree checks passed. Updated the existing unclaimed independent review request to the new source SHA; update operation is pending.
